_how: Look at data/out/imagery/*.png (or imagery_check.pdf) and fill each 'verdict'. Blocks: 'dense live conifer' / 'live, moderately dense' / 'mostly dead (gray crowns)'. Waypoints: what the photos show at the point, e.g. 'inside dense live conifer', 'poor bed: leafless aspen edge, cover 250 m west'. Leave blank to skip. Then re-run `elkscout waypoints` (if any block is dead) and `elkscout report`.
